## Measurement note
`cmd/symdesk` tests hang on this machine until the Go test timeout (blocked `database/sql.OpenDB` goroutine; reproducible on unmodified `main` and at `v0.6.11`). CI on the exact HEAD SHA runs `go test -count=1 ./...` green on both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest, so the hang is local-environment-specific (local Go 1.26.5 vs CI 1.26.4). To keep the baseline delta apples-to-apples, both HEAD and the `v0.6.11` baseline were measured over the identical package subset excluding `cmd/symdesk`. Three `internal/service` tests (`TestRoundtrip`, `TestNoteDeleteAndTrashRestoreKeepSidecarConsistent`, `TestNoteMoveRemovesStaleIndexEntry`) fail locally at both HEAD and baseline but pass in CI — pre-existing local-environment failures, coverage still recorded.

## Findings
- [ ] **[Tests/Design] CLI exec test suite hangs on developer machines (blocked DB open)**
  - **Status quo:** `cmd/symdesk` tests (`TestLsCommandExecution`, `cli_exec_test.go:286`, and at least one more) block until the 600s Go test timeout on a blocked `database/sql.OpenDB` goroutine; reproducible on clean `main` and at `v0.6.11`, while CI (Go 1.26.4, ubuntu + macos) is green. This makes the package unmeasurable locally and hides its coverage from every local report.
  - **Likely cause:** The exec-level tests added around #148/#150 open the sidecar DB through a path that deadlocks under local conditions (Go 1.26.5 or machine state) instead of failing fast.
  - **Proposed solution:** Make the sidecar DB open in tests fail fast (busy timeout / context deadline) and isolate the exec tests from any shared DB path; verify the package completes locally within seconds.
  - **Uncovered:** n/a
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / high impact
